annotations.body: To clarify here, I don't think we should ever prune proofs needed for fragments. We should always retain them. This is because I think ultimately we want to use sedimentree as the on disk format. I want to be able to load a fragment and know that if we have the causal predecessors of the fragment, then we will be able to apply it. If we prune signatures then we won't be able to save such chunks.
